notes: Not standard RNA-seq: RNC-seq, RNA from ribosome-nascent chain complexes pelleted through a sucrose cushion (assay_class other). Both arms overexpress S1 (WT or K247Q) with IPTG; no reference-genotype control, so is_control left out. Gene name rpsA for S1 protein. K247Q labelled point_mutation (overexpressed mutant). Phase left out (3 h after IPTG at OD 0.6).

inducer_added.q: 1mM IPTG was added to the strains

treatment.q: S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains grown in LB medium are used for RNC-seq

transcription_arrested.q: S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains grown in LB medium are used for RNC-seq

mixed_organism.q: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 S1WT and S1K247Q overexpression strains

assay_class.q: ultracentrifuged at 4°C by T-865 fixed angle rotor (ThermoFisher, Germany) to pellet RNCs
